hero.title: Hi, I’m Dival Sehgal
hero.subtitle: Senior Software Engineer — Building scalable full-stack systems across frontend architecture, cloud-integrated backends, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience architecting and shipping full-stack web applications — from performant React/Next.js frontends to GraphQL/REST APIs, serverless functions, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.

On the frontend, I build data-driven dashboards, multi-brand eCommerce platforms, and scalable design systems using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. On the backend, I've built and extended AWS AppSync GraphQL resolvers with Python/AWS Lambda, orchestrated multi-source data into federated GraphQL layers, and shipped scheduled Azure Functions for large-scale SEO automation.

I also focus on AI-assisted development — standardising LLM-powered workflows with Copilot, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers integrated with Figma and Jira/Azure DevOps — to accelerate design-to-code delivery across teams.
Outside of work, I enjoy hiking, exploring national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, and spending time in nature — it helps me reset and approach complex problems with clarity.

experience.company: EPAM Systems — Clients: Philips Healthcare, Princess Auto

description.text: Engineered healthcare web applications for Philips Healthcare using Next.js, Contentful CMS, and AWS AppSync — orchestrating data from multiple backend services into a unified GraphQL layer.
Built and extended AWS AppSync GraphQL resolvers using Python (AWS Lambda), transforming Contentful content into a federated GraphQL schema with strongly typed, reusable API responses.

Led a 3-engineer team on a Contentful CMS migration for Princess Auto (Canadian retail chain), enabling marketing to independently manage 100% of dynamic site content across listings, showcases, guides, campaigns, and recommendation modules.

Standardised AI-assisted development workflows using LLMs (Copilot, Claude Code), Model Context Protocol servers, and reusable prompt/skill files — accelerating code generation, design-to-code implementation, and Jira/Azure DevOps-driven development.
Architected a TypeScript monorepo (Turborepo) with shared design tokens and a component library via Storybook, improving consistency and accessibility across applications.
Built scheduled Azure Functions to auto-generate XML sitemaps for large-scale product and category inventory, improving SEO crawl efficiency.
Drove a 25% increase in user engagement by re-architecting the Advisor Dashboard into a real-time analytics platform, using Hotjar data to inform UX optimizations.
Modernized the Advisor Onboarding Flow by migrating from Ember.js to Next.js, integrating Tipalti and Jumio for automated tax and identity compliance.
Consolidated Feedback, Availability Manager, and Customer Support modules into a unified experience, leveraging pub/sub and polling mechanisms for real-time chat availability.
Integrated Zendesk Chatbot to streamline support flows and reduce manual response overhead.
Led the Shukran Delivery Project for Max Fashion and Home Centre, integrating same-day delivery across multiple store locations and driving a 25% increase in non-GDMS orders.
Built personalized banners via Amplience CMS segmented by user landing source and behaviour, using Monetate for variant injection and A/B testing on production without engineering deployments.
Enhanced flash sales and recommendation rails UX, driving a 30% boost in user engagement across all Landmark brands.
Revamped area location and product listing filters, improving accessibility and product discoverability by 20%.
Optimized website performance via Lighthouse audits, reducing page load time and cumulative layout shifts, decreasing bounce rate by 10%.

Developed a KYC Dashboard for Stanza Living aggregating 10,000–50,000 monthly booking requests across multiple apps into a centralized management interface, integrating Aadhaar API for real-time identity verification.
Built an Ad Campaign Dashboard managing 1,000+ monthly campaigns with performance tracking, analytics, and workflow automation, reducing manual overhead by ~30%.
Architected role-based routing and an atomic component structure for Narayan Edtech's platform to enable scalable feature development.
Developed an internal Shuttle Service App with an Admin Dashboard for managing client visits, ride-sharing, cab bookings, and seat allocation.
